_comment: Example of what the detector actually emits, for all three fixtures. This is the payload the live coaching UI renders and the report card consumes. A flag has two parts: it is RAISED when an obligation is triggered, and RESOLVED when there is evidence in the transcript that it was met. Acknowledging a flag in the UI does not resolve it — only evidence does.

resolution_status.satisfied: Evidence in the transcript shows the obligation was met. resolution.evidence points at the turn.
resolution_status.missed: The call ended and no turn satisfies the obligation.
resolution_status.unverified: The obligation cannot be settled from the call audio alone — it is discharged after the call (a letter, a system action). Neither pass nor fail; it needs a system-side check.

flags.obligation: Assess the hardship notice and notify the customer of the decision
flags.staff_prompt: Hardship notice received. 21-day clock started. Tell the customer the hardship process exists and lodge it.

resolution.reason: Staff named the hardship notice, stated it was being lodged on the call, and set the 21-day expectation at 105800.

flags.obligation: Inform the customer that hardship provisions exist under the National Credit Code
flags.authority: ABA industry guideline — Banks' financial difficulty programs
flags.staff_prompt: Tell the customer hardship provisions exist. Most customers do not know.

flags.obligation: If a variation deferring or reducing obligations for more than 90 days is agreed, send written notice of the contract changes
flags.staff_prompt: If a variation over 90 days is agreed, written notice is due within 30 days.

resolution.reason: Discharged after the call by a system action, not by anything said on it. No in-call evidence can settle this. Needs a system-side check.

call_002._comment: Correct output is an empty array. The customer uses hardship vocabulary ('struggling', 'couldn't afford') but states a specific recovery date and confirms future repayments are manageable, so no obligation is triggered. Emitting any flag here is a false positive.

flags.obligation: Assess the hardship notice and notify the customer of the decision
flags.staff_prompt: Hardship notice received. 21-day clock started. Tell the customer the hardship process exists and lodge it.

resolution.reason: No turn lodges a hardship notice or references the process. An informal arrangement was offered instead at 64600, which starts no statutory clock and creates no decision on record.

flags.obligation: Inform the customer that hardship provisions exist under the National Credit Code
flags.authority: ABA industry guideline — Banks' financial difficulty programs
flags.staff_prompt: The customer has directly asked whether a process exists. Name the hardship provisions.

resolution.reason: Customer asked directly. Staff answered 'there are options but they'd depend on your circumstances' at 111000 and returned to the informal arrangement without naming the provisions.
